title: Burkhard Heim and Martin's RIAS anti-gravity outfit

tellings.quote: you know, stuff and then he was brought over to the US and I think he worked with Lockheed Martin or Martin Corporation pre-Lockheed merger.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about a physicist named Burkhard Heim. Michels says he thinks Heim was brought over to the United States and worked with the Martin company, an aircraft maker, before it merged into Lockheed Martin, in an outfit that studied anti-gravity. If true, it would mean an American aerospace firm quietly took in a foreign physicist for gravity research.
